description: This file contains functions for importing notes, processing attachments, and managing notebooks within the Notesnook project. It handles encryption, database interactions, and content type conversions.

methods.name: importNote
methods.description: Main function to import a note, processing attachments and note content.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Processes and encrypts attachments, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: processNote
methods.description: Processes note content, tags, colors, and associated notebooks, and saves to database.

methods.name: importNotebook
methods.description: Recursively imports notebooks and their children, creating new entries if necessary.
